subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking from New York to London on June 15th, 2022. Your flight details are as follows: Flight Number: ABC123, Departure Time: 10:00 AM, Seat: 24A. Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours prior to departure. If you have any questions or require assistance, feel free to contact us. We look forward to welcoming you on board! Safe travels, The Airline Team
